reason: A DSH Web plugin for image-based question answering that routes questions and image data from a primary model to a selected multimodal vision model, with streaming UI, follow-up context, and model settings.

summaries.zh: 通过选定的多模态视觉模型对图片进行问答，并在界面中实时展示提问、回答和追问上下文。
summaries.en: Ask questions about images through a selected multimodal vision model while viewing streamed answers and follow-up context in the interface.

capabilities: Reads image files from provided paths
Detects PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF formats
Sends image data and questions to a selected multimodal vision model
Streams and displays visual question-answer results
Persists selected vision-model provider and model settings
Maintains same-image follow-up context and session transcripts
